All questions are required and all necessary working must be shown clearly. Use a scientific calculator where appropriate; geometrical instruments are required and tracing paper is permitted. The formula list is on QP p2. Unless a question specifies otherwise, give non-exact numerical answers to 3 significant figures, or angles in degrees to 1 decimal place. Use the calculator value of π or 3.142.

Calculator where appropriate, MF19 needed, necessary working required; unsupported calculator answers receive no marks. Paper-cover instructions shared by every question: answer all questions in the answer booklet; show all necessary working clearly; use a calculator where appropriate; and give non-exact numerical answers to 3 significant figures unless a question specifies otherwise. Question pages provide marks in brackets but no response slots. Unsupported calculator answers receive no marks; angles in degrees default to one decimal place.
